metadata.title: End Process Validation
metadata.purposeAndUsage: MANDATORY final step for every process. Validates that all operating principles were followed throughout the process.

output.description: Compliance report documenting adherence to operating principles

specificActions: Read log.json to review all user interactions logged during the process
Verify Principle 1 (LOG FIRST): Check that all user interactions were logged BEFORE responses
Verify Principle 2 (READ JSON): Check that step JSON files were read for guidance
Verify Principle 3 (STOP AT CHECKPOINTS): Check that approval checkpoints waited for user response
Verify Principle 4 (NO TODOS): Check that todo_write was not used during the process
Verify Principle 5 (VERIFY ACTIONS): Check that mandatory actions had output confirmations
If violations found: Report to user before completing
If no violations: Output '✓ All operating principles followed - process compliant'
bestPractices: Be thorough - check every user interaction in the log
Report violations honestly - do not hide them
Violations should be documented for continuous improvement

substeps.name: Read Process Log
substeps.description: Read log.json to get full execution history

substeps.name: Check Principle 1: LOG FIRST
substeps.description: Verify all user interactions were logged before responses
actions: For each user interaction in the process:
Check: Was it logged to log.json?
Check: Was it logged BEFORE the response/file change?

substeps.name: Check Principle 3: STOP AT CHECKPOINTS
substeps.description: Verify approval checkpoints were handled correctly
actions: For each step with approvalRequired: true:
Check: Did agent stop and wait for approval?
Check: Was approval logged before proceeding?

substeps.name: Check Principle 4: NO TODOS
actions: Review log for any todo_write tool usage
Note if external todos were created

substeps.name: Generate Compliance Report
substeps.description: Document compliance status and any violations
actions: If clean: Output '✓ All operating principles followed'

flow.description: Read log → Check each principle → Document findings → Report

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: All previous steps in memory.json, full log.json
